sources.topic: Structure variable selectors, field priority and right-most lookup; dynamic capture timing and builtin forms are explicit Pythonic choices

contract.selectors: Existing named STRUCTURE or VECTOR/CONFIG/XYZWPR/XYZWPREXT/POSITION records; dotted, indexed and grouped storage; calls inside indexes only
contract.capture: Reference selection once left-to-right on each entry, even for an empty body; no data copy or field-initialization demand; prior effects survive later selector failure
contract.control_flow: Keep selection across internal jumps and pause/resume; recapture on block reentry; existing ancestor-only entry restrictions and routine cleanup
contract.handlers: Freeze enclosing references in predicate/action defaults at definition; inner handler USING captures on action execution
contract.effects: Retain source roots and once-per-entry selector calls for transitive global/formal writes and active-counter checks
contract.protection: Exact existing outputs, overlaps, capacities, initialization, CONFIG bounds and recursively protected POSITION orientation fields remain
contract.reporting: using_scopes adds capture_once and selector_types; preserve source paths, IDs, lexical bindings and original source mapping

boundaries: No function-result/computed or whole ARRAY/resource/joint selectors, field FOR counters or dynamic caller scope
Captured PATH node identity does not imply automatic retargeting after collection removal or replacement
No native selector-timing, builtin-form, namespace, ABI or alias-lifetime claim; strict remains future work
